segments.speaker: Rekha Sharma
segments.text: Good afternoon. This is the transport review before the winter term changes.

segments.speaker: Joseph Kurian
segments.text: Afternoon, ma'am. I've brought the route sheets and the complaint register.

segments.speaker: Rekha Sharma
segments.text: Let's start with route 4. Parents keep writing about it.

segments.speaker: Joseph Kurian
segments.text: Route 4 has fifty two children now. The ride from the first stop is over an hour.

segments.speaker: Manoj Tiwari
segments.text: My neighbour's daughter is on it. She leaves home at 6:20 in the morning.

segments.speaker: Farida Ansari
segments.text: That's too long for the primary children. Some are only six years old.

segments.speaker: Joseph Kurian
segments.text: We have the spare bus from the old contract. With two more drivers we could split the route.

segments.speaker: Rekha Sharma
segments.text: What would that cost us?

segments.speaker: Farida Ansari
segments.text: Two drivers and fuel, about one lakh ten thousand a month. It fits in the transport fee we already collect.

segments.speaker: Rekha Sharma
segments.text: Then route 4 is split into two routes from January.

segments.speaker: Joseph Kurian
segments.text: 4A and 4B, I'll draw the new stops this week.

segments.speaker: Manoj Tiwari
segments.text: Parents will be very relieved to hear that.

segments.speaker: Rekha Sharma
segments.text: For the two new drivers, police verification has to be done before they drive a single child.

segments.speaker: Joseph Kurian
segments.text: Yes, ma'am. I have two candidates already, both with school bus experience.

segments.speaker: Rekha Sharma
segments.text: Joseph, I want the police verification for both drivers complete by 10 December.

segments.speaker: Joseph Kurian
segments.text: I'll get both verifications done by 10 December.

segments.speaker: Farida Ansari
segments.text: Please also bring their licence copies to the office for the file.

segments.speaker: Joseph Kurian
segments.text: Of course.

segments.speaker: Manoj Tiwari
segments.text: Another issue, route 2. Children reach school just as the bell rings.

segments.speaker: Joseph Kurian
segments.text: There's construction near the flyover, it adds ten minutes most days.

segments.speaker: Farida Ansari
segments.text: Three late marks last week were from route 2 children.

segments.speaker: Rekha Sharma
segments.text: Then the route 2 pickup moves ten minutes earlier. First stop at 7:05 instead of 7:15.

segments.speaker: Joseph Kurian
segments.text: I'll inform the driver and the attendant today.

segments.speaker: Rekha Sharma
segments.text: Parents must hear about both changes officially, not through gossip at the bus stop.

segments.speaker: Farida Ansari
segments.text: I'll send the circular to parents the day after tomorrow, with the new timings and the route 4 split.

segments.speaker: Rekha Sharma
segments.text: Good. Make it clear that the route 4 split starts in January, not now.

segments.speaker: Manoj Tiwari
segments.text: Please send it after school hours, parents read messages in the evening.

segments.speaker: Farida Ansari
segments.text: Also, the annual day rehearsal is on 5 December, so the office will be busy that day.

segments.speaker: Rekha Sharma
segments.text: Yes, everyone is needed for the rehearsal, so the circular has to go before that.

segments.speaker: Manoj Tiwari
segments.text: Can I raise one more thing on behalf of the parents? We'd like CCTV cameras in all buses.

segments.speaker: Farida Ansari
segments.text: Cameras in fourteen buses, plus recording storage, that's a big amount.

segments.speaker: Rekha Sharma
segments.text: It's a fair request, but it's not in this year's budget. We'll consider it for next year.

segments.speaker: Manoj Tiwari
segments.text: I'll tell the parents' committee it's for next year then.

segments.speaker: Joseph Kurian
segments.text: Bus 6 and bus 7 have a problem too, the GPS trackers keep going offline.

segments.speaker: Farida Ansari
segments.text: Parents use the app to see where the bus is. They call the office when it disappears.

segments.speaker: Rekha Sharma
segments.text: Someone has to check the GPS trackers on buses 6 and 7.

segments.speaker: Joseph Kurian
segments.text: The vendor's technician comes only on request, and I'm busy with the drivers.

segments.speaker: Farida Ansari
segments.text: I'm not technical enough for that, honestly.

segments.speaker: Rekha Sharma
segments.text: All right, we'll find somebody to deal with the trackers.

segments.speaker: Manoj Tiwari
segments.text: What about the attendant on route 9? Parents say she's very good.

segments.speaker: Rekha Sharma
segments.text: That's nice to hear. Joseph, please pass that on to her.

segments.speaker: Joseph Kurian
segments.text: I will, she'll be happy.

segments.speaker: Farida Ansari
segments.text: The fuel bills for October came in higher than budget.

segments.speaker: Joseph Kurian
segments.text: Diesel went up, and route 4 has been taking the longer road.

segments.speaker: Rekha Sharma
segments.text: Once the route is split, that should come down.

segments.speaker: Farida Ansari
segments.text: I'll keep an eye on it in the December accounts.

segments.speaker: Manoj Tiwari
segments.text: One last thing, the bus stop near the temple has no shade. Children wait in the sun.

segments.speaker: Rekha Sharma
segments.text: We can ask the society if they'll let us put a small shelter there.

segments.speaker: Manoj Tiwari
segments.text: I know the society secretary, I'll ask him informally.

segments.speaker: Rekha Sharma
segments.text: Thank you, Mr Tiwari. That's all for today, I think.

segments.speaker: Joseph Kurian
segments.text: Thank you, ma'am.

decisions.fact: Bus route 4 is split into two routes starting January.
The route 2 pickup moves ten minutes earlier, first stop at 7:05.

action_items.fact: Joseph completes police verification for the two new drivers.
Farida sends parents a circular on the route 2 timing and the route 4 split.
The GPS trackers on buses 6 and 7 are checked; no one was assigned.

distractors.fact: CCTV cameras in all buses were requested and deferred to next year.
5 December is the annual day rehearsal, not the circular's date.
